verses.text: Solomon, David pikin, become strong for im kingdom, and di Lord im God dey with am and make am very great.
Solomon talk to all Israel, to di captains of thousands and of hundreds, to di judges, to every prince for all Israel and to di heads of di papa dem houses.
So Solomon and all di gathering wey dey with am go di high place wey dey Gibeon, because God Tent of Meeting dey there, wey Moses, di servant of di Lord, make for di wilderness.
But David don bring up di ark of God from Kiriath Jearim to di place wey David prepare for am, because e pitch tent for am for Jerusalem.
Di bronze altar wey Bezalel, Uri pikin, Hur pikin, make dey there before di tabernacle of di Lord too, and Solomon and di gathering go look for di Lord there.
Solomon go up there to di bronze altar before di Lord, wey dey di Tent of Meeting, and e offer 1,000 burnt sacrifice on am.
For dat night God appear to Solomon and talk to am say, “Ask wetin I go give you.”
Solomon talk to God say, “You don show my papa David big mercy, and you don make me king for im place.
Now, di Lord God, make your promise to my papa David stand, because you don make me king over people wey plenty like dust of di earth.
Now give me wisdom and knowledge, so that I go fit go out and come in before dis people, because who fit judge dis your big people?”

God talk to Solomon say, “Because dis one dey your heart, and you no ask for riches, wealth or honor, or for di life of dem wey hate you, and you no ask for long life, but you ask for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, so that you go judge my people wey I don make you king over,
I don give you wisdom and knowledge. I go give you riches, wealth and honor too, wey no king wey dey before you get, and nobody after you go get like am.”
So Solomon come from di high place wey dey Gibeon, from before di Tent of Meeting, go Jerusalem, and e rule over Israel.
Solomon gather chariots and horsemen. E get 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen, wey e put for di chariot cities and with di king for Jerusalem.
Di king make silver and gold dey Jerusalem like stones, and e make cedars dey like di sycamore trees wey dey di low land, because dem plenty.
Dem bring Solomon horses from Egypt, and di king merchants dey receive dem for groups, each group for price.

Dem dey bring up and carry out of Egypt one chariot for 600 shekels of silver and one horse for 150. And na so dem dey bring dem out for all di kings of di Hittites and for di kings of Syria through dem hand.
Now Solomon decide to build house for di name of di Lord and house for im kingdom.
Solomon count 70,000 men to carry loads, 80,000 men to cut stone for di mountains and 3,600 to oversee dem.
Solomon send to Huram king of Tyre say, “As you do with my papa David, and send am cedars to build house for am to stay, na so do for me.

Look, I wan build house for di name of di Lord my God, to give am to am, to burn incense of sweet spices before am, and for di bread of di presence always, and for di burnt sacrifice for morning and evening, for Sabbaths, for new moons and for di fixed feasts of di Lord our God. Dis na rule forever for Israel.
Di house wey I wan build go big, because our God big pass all gods.
But who fit build house for am, as heaven and di highest heaven no fit hold am? Who be me, say I go build house for am, except only to burn incense before am?

So now send me one man wey get skill to work gold, silver, bronze, iron, purple, red and blue cloth, and wey know how to carve, to dey with di skilled men wey dey with me for Judah and for Jerusalem, wey my papa David provide.
Send me cedar trees, cypress trees and almug trees from Lebanon too, because I know say your servants know how to cut wood for Lebanon, and look, my servants go dey with your servants,
to prepare plenty wood for me, because di house wey I wan build go big and wonderful.
Look, I go give your servants, di cutters wey cut di wood, 20,000 measures of beaten wheat, 20,000 measures of barley, 20,000 baths of wine and 20,000 baths of oil.”
Den Huram king of Tyre answer for writing, wey e send to Solomon say, “Because di Lord love im people, e don make you king over dem.”

Huram talk again say, “Make dem bless di Lord, di God of Israel, wey make heaven and earth, wey don give King David wise pikin, wey get wisdom and understanding, wey go build house for di Lord and house for im kingdom.
Now I don send skilled man, wey get understanding, Huram Abi,

di pikin of one woman from Dan pikin dem, and im papa na man from Tyre. E get skill to work gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, wood, purple, blue, fine linen and red cloth, and to carve any kind of carving and to design any design wey dem go give am, with your skilled men and with di skilled men of my oga David, your papa.
So now make my oga send di wheat and di barley, di oil and di wine wey e talk about to im servants,
and we go cut wood from Lebanon, as much as you need, and bring am to you for rafts by sea go Joppa, and you go carry am up go Jerusalem.”
Solomon count all di foreigners wey dey Israel land, after di census wey im papa David count dem, and dem find 153,600.
E put 70,000 of dem to carry loads, 80,000 to cut stone for di mountains and 3,600 overseers to make di people work.
Den Solomon begin to build di Lord house for Jerusalem, for Mount Moriah, wia di Lord appear to im papa David, for di place wey David prepare, for Ornan di Jebusite threshing floor.
E begin to build for di second month, for di second day, for di fourth year of im rule.
Dis na di foundation wey Solomon lay to build God house. Di length na 60 cubits by di first measure, and di width na 20 cubits.
Di porch wey dey front, im length na 20 cubits, as di width of di house be, and di height na 120. E cover am inside with pure gold.
Di big house e cover with cypress wood, and e cover am with fine gold, and e put palm trees and chains on am.
E decorate di house with precious stones for beauty, and di gold na gold from Parvaim.
E cover di house too, di beams, di thresholds, im walls and im doors with gold, and e carve cherubim on di walls.
E make di Most Holy Place. Im length na 20 cubits, as di width of di house be, and im width na 20 cubits, and e cover am with fine gold, wey weigh 600 talents.
Di weight of di nails na 50 shekels of gold. E cover di upper rooms with gold.
For di Most Holy Place e make two cherubim of carved work, and dem cover dem with gold.
Di wings of di cherubim na 20 cubits long. One wing of di first, five cubits, touch di wall of di house, and di other wing, five cubits, join di wing of di other cherub.
One wing of di other cherub, five cubits, touch di wall of di house, and di other wing, five cubits, join di wing of di first cherub.
Di wings of dis cherubim spread out 20 cubits, and dem stand on dem feet, and dem face turn toward di house.
E make di veil with blue, purple, red and fine linen, and e work cherubim on am.
For front of di house e make two pillars, 35 cubits high, and di top wey dey on top of each one na five cubits.
E make chains for di inner sanctuary and put dem on top of di pillars, and e make 100 pomegranates and put dem on di chains.
E set up di pillars before di temple, one for di right and di other for di left, and e call di name of di one for di right Jachin, and di name of di one for di left Boaz.
Again e make altar of bronze, 20 cubits im length, 20 cubits im width and ten cubits im height.
E make di melted sea, ten cubits from one edge to di other, round, and im height na five cubits, and one line of 30 cubits go round am.
Under am na di shape of oxen wey go round am, for ten cubits, dey go round di sea. Di oxen dey for two rows, dem cast dem as dem cast di sea.
E stand on 12 oxen, three dey face north, three dey face west, three dey face south and three dey face east, and dem set di sea on top of dem, and all dem back parts dey inside.
E thick like one hand width, and im edge dey like edge of cup, with flowers of lily. E fit carry 3,000 baths.

E make ten basins too and put five for di right and five for di left, to wash inside dem. Dem dey wash di things wey belong to di burnt sacrifice inside dem, but di sea na for di priests to wash inside.
E make ten gold lampstands as dem rule, and put dem for di temple, five for di right and five for di left.
E make ten tables too and put dem for di temple, five for di right side and five for di left. E make 100 gold basins.
Again e make di court of di priests and di big court, and doors for di court, and cover dem doors with bronze.
E set di sea for di right side of di east end, toward di south.
Huram make di pots, di shovels and di basins. So Huram finish di work wey e work for King Solomon for God house:
di two pillars, di bowls, di two tops wey dey on top of di pillars, di two networks to cover di two bowls of di tops wey dey on top of di pillars,
and di 400 pomegranates for di two networks, two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover di two bowls of di tops wey dey on di pillars.
E make di bases too, and di basins wey dey on di bases,
one sea and di 12 oxen under am.
Di pots too, di shovels, di forks and all dem vessels, Huram Abi make dem for King Solomon for di Lord house, of bright bronze.
For di plain of Jordan di king cast dem, for di clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
So Solomon make all dis vessels plenty well well, because dem no fit find out di weight of di bronze.
Solomon make all di vessels wey dey God house, di gold altar too, and di tables wey di bread of di presence dey on,
and di lampstands with dem lamps, to burn as di rule before di inner sanctuary, of pure gold,
and di flowers, di lamps and di tongs, of gold, and dat one na perfect gold,
and di snuffers, di basins, di spoons and di fire pans, of pure gold. As for di entrance of di house, im inner doors for di Most Holy Place and di doors of di house, di temple, na gold.

So all di work wey Solomon do for di Lord house finish. Solomon bring in di things wey im papa David don give to God, di silver, di gold and all di vessels, and put dem for di treasuries of God house.

Den Solomon gather di elders of Israel and all di heads of di tribes, di princes of di papa dem houses of Israel pikin dem, to Jerusalem, to bring up di ark of di covenant of di Lord from David city, wey be Zion.
All di men of Israel gather to di king for di feast, wey dey di seventh month.
All di elders of Israel come, and di Levites carry di ark.
Dem bring up di ark and di Tent of Meeting and all di holy vessels wey dey di Tent. Na di priests, di Levites, bring dem up.
King Solomon and all di gathering of Israel wey gather to am before di ark dey make sacrifice of sheep and oxen wey nobody fit count because dem plenty.
Di priests bring di ark of di covenant of di Lord enter im place, enter di inner sanctuary of di house, di Most Holy Place, under di wings of di cherubim.
Because di cherubim spread dem wings over di place of di ark, and di cherubim cover di ark and im poles from up.
Di poles long so tay dem see di ends of di poles from di holy place for front of di inner sanctuary, but dem no see dem for outside. And dem dey there till today.
Nothing dey inside di ark except di two stone tablets wey Moses put there for Horeb, as di Lord make covenant with Israel pikin dem as dem comot from Egypt.
As di priests comot from di holy place, because all di priests wey dey there don make dem holy and dem no dey keep dem groups,

and di Levites wey be singers, all of dem, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and dem pikin dem and dem brothers, wey wear fine linen, with cymbals, stringed instruments and harps, stand for di east end of di altar, and 120 priests dey blow trumpets with dem,

e happen say as di trumpeters and di singers be like one person, to make one sound to hear as dem dey praise and thank di Lord, and as dem lift up dem voice with trumpets, cymbals and instruments of music and praise di Lord, say, “Because e good, because im mercy no dey end,” den cloud fill di house, di Lord house,
so tay di priests no fit stand to serve because of di cloud, because di glory of di Lord fill God house.
Den Solomon talk say, “Di Lord don talk say e go stay inside thick darkness.
But I don build house for you to stay, one place for you to stay forever.”
Di king turn im face and bless all di gathering of Israel, and all di gathering of Israel dey stand.
E talk say, “Make dem bless di Lord, di God of Israel, wey talk with im mouth to my papa David and don finish am with im hands, say,

‘From di day wey I bring my people comot from Egypt land, I no choose any city from all di tribes of Israel to build house, so that my name go dey there, and I no choose any man to be prince over my people Israel,
but I don choose Jerusalem, so that my name go dey there, and I don choose David to rule my people Israel.’
Now e dey my papa David heart to build house for di name of di Lord, di God of Israel.
But di Lord talk to my papa David say, ‘As e dey your heart to build house for my name, you do well say e dey your heart.
But still, you no go build di house, but your pikin wey go come from your body, na im go build di house for my name.’

Di Lord don do di word wey e talk, because I don rise for my papa David place, and I sit for di throne of Israel, as di Lord promise, and I don build di house for di name of di Lord, di God of Israel.
I don put di ark there, wey di covenant of di Lord dey inside, wey e make with Israel pikin dem.”
E stand before di altar of di Lord for front of all di gathering of Israel and spread out im hands,

because Solomon don make bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high, and put am for di middle of di court. E stand on am, kneel down on im knees before all di gathering of Israel and spread out im hands toward heaven,
and talk say, “Di Lord, di God of Israel, no God dey like you, for heaven or for earth, wey dey keep covenant and mercy with your servants wey dey waka before you with all dem heart,
wey don keep wetin you promise your servant, my papa David. Yes, you talk with your mouth, and you don finish am with your hand, as e be today.

So now, di Lord, di God of Israel, keep wetin you promise your servant, my papa David, say, ‘Man no go fail to sit for Israel throne before me, if only your pikin dem take care of dem way, to waka for my law as you don waka before me.’
So now, di Lord, di God of Israel, make your word wey you talk to your servant David come true.
“But God go really stay with men for earth? Look, heaven and di highest heaven no fit hold you, how much less dis house wey I don build!
Still, look at di prayer of your servant and im cry for mercy, di Lord my God, to listen to di cry and to di prayer wey your servant dey pray before you,
so that your eyes go dey open toward dis house night and day, toward di place wey you talk about say you go put your name there, to listen to di prayer wey your servant go pray toward dis place.
Listen to di cry of your servant and of your people Israel, as dem go pray toward dis place. Yes, hear from your place to stay, even from heaven, and as you hear, forgive.
“If man sin against im neighbor, and dem put oath on am to make am swear, and e come swear before your altar for dis house,
den hear from heaven, and act, and judge your servants, pay di wicked back, bring im way on im own head, and show say di righteous no get fault, to give am as im righteousness be.
“If your people Israel lose for front of di enemy because dem sin against you, and dem turn come back and confess your name, and pray and cry to you for mercy for dis house,
den hear from heaven, and forgive di sin of your people Israel, and bring dem back to di land wey you give dem and dem papa dem.
“As di sky close and rain no fall because dem sin against you, if dem pray toward dis place, and confess your name, and turn from dem sin as you punish dem,

den hear for heaven, and forgive di sin of your servants and of your people Israel, as you teach dem di good way wey dem suppose waka, and send rain on your land wey you don give your people as inheritance.
“If hunger dey for di land, if sickness dey spread, if dem get blight, mildew, locust or caterpillar, if dem enemies surround dem for di land of dem cities, any plague or any sickness wey dey,
any prayer or cry for mercy wey any man make, or all your people Israel, as each one go know im own plague and im own sorrow, and spread out im hands for dis house,
den hear from heaven, your place to stay, and forgive, and give every man as all im ways be, di one wey you know im heart, because na only you know di hearts of man pikin dem,
so that dem go fear you, to waka for your ways as long as dem dey live for di land wey you give our papa dem.

“Again, about di foreigner wey no be from your people Israel, as e go come from far country because of your big name and your strong hand and your stretched out arm, if dem come and pray toward dis house,

den hear from heaven, from your place to stay, and do all wetin di foreigner call you for, so that all di peoples of di earth go know your name, and fear you as your people Israel dey do, and know say dem dey call dis house wey I don build by your name.
“If your people go out to battle against dem enemies, by di way wey you go send dem, and dem pray to you toward dis city wey you choose and di house wey I don build for your name,
den hear from heaven dem prayer and dem cry for mercy, and defend dem cause.
“If dem sin against you, because nobody dey wey no dey sin, and you vex with dem and give dem to di enemy, so that dem carry dem go as prisoners to land wey far or near,
but if dem think am for di land wey dem carry dem go as prisoners, and turn and cry to you for mercy for di land of dem captivity, say, ‘We don sin, we don do wrong and we don do wickedness,’

if dem return to you with all dem heart and with all dem soul for di land of dem captivity, wia dem carry dem go as prisoners, and pray toward dem land wey you give dem papa dem, and toward di city wey you choose, and toward di house wey I don build for your name,
den hear from heaven, from your place to stay, dem prayer and dem cry for mercy, and defend dem cause, and forgive your people wey sin against you.
“Now, my God, I beg you, make your eyes dey open and your ears dey listen to di prayer wey dem make for dis place.
So now stand up, di Lord God, go enter your resting place, you and di ark of your strength. Make your priests, di Lord God, wear salvation, and make your holy people rejoice for goodness.
Di Lord God, no turn away di face of your anointed one. Remember your mercy to David your servant.”
As Solomon finish to pray, fire come down from heaven and burn di burnt sacrifice and di sacrifices, and di glory of di Lord fill di house.
Di priests no fit enter di Lord house, because di glory of di Lord fill di Lord house.

All Israel pikin dem look as di fire come down and di glory of di Lord dey on di house. Dem bow with dem face to di ground for di pavement, worship and give thanks to di Lord say, “Because e good, because im mercy no dey end.”
Den di king and all di people offer sacrifice before di Lord.
King Solomon offer sacrifice of 22,000 cattle and 120,000 sheep. So di king and all di people dedicate God house.

Di priests stand as dem duties be. Di Levites dey with di instruments of music of di Lord, wey King David make to give thanks to di Lord, because im mercy no dey end, as David dey praise through dem service. Di priests dey blow trumpets before dem, and all Israel dey stand.

Solomon make di middle of di court wey dey before di Lord house holy, because na there e offer di burnt sacrifice and di fat of di peace sacrifice, because di bronze altar wey Solomon make no fit hold di burnt sacrifice, di grain sacrifice and di fat.
So Solomon hold di feast for dat time seven days, and all Israel with am, one very big gathering, from di entrance of Hamath reach di stream of Egypt.
For di eighth day dem hold holy gathering, because dem keep di dedication of di altar seven days and di feast seven days.
For di 23rd day of di seventh month e send di people go dem tents, wey dem dey happy and glad for heart for di goodness wey di Lord show David, Solomon and Israel im people.
So Solomon finish di Lord house and di king house, and all wey come into Solomon heart to make for di Lord house and for im own house, e do am well.
Di Lord appear to Solomon for night and talk to am say, “I don hear your prayer, and I don choose dis place for myself as house of sacrifice.
If I close di sky so that rain no go dey, or if I command di locust to eat di land, or if I send plague among my people,
if my people, wey dem call by my name, go humble demselves, pray, look for my face and turn from dem wicked ways, den I go hear from heaven, forgive dem sin and heal dem land.
Now my eyes go dey open and my ears go dey listen to di prayer wey dem make for dis place.
Because now I don choose and make dis house holy, so that my name go dey there forever, and my eyes and my heart go dey there always.
As for you, if you go waka before me, as your papa David waka, and do all wey I command you, and keep my laws and my rules,
den I go make di throne of your kingdom stand, as I make covenant with your papa David say, ‘Man no go fail to rule Israel for you.’
But if una turn away and leave my laws and my commands wey I set before una, and go serve other gods and worship dem,
den I go pull dem up by di root from my land wey I don give dem, and dis house, wey I don make holy for my name, I go throw am out of my sight, and I go make am proverb and joke among all peoples.
Dis house, wey high so, go shock everybody wey pass am, so tay e go talk say, ‘Why di Lord do dis kind thing to dis land and to dis house?’
Dem go answer say, ‘Because dem leave di Lord, di God of dem papa dem, wey bring dem comot from Egypt land, and hold other gods, and worship dem and serve dem. So e don bring all dis evil on dem.’”
For di end of 20 years, as Solomon don build di Lord house and im own house,
Solomon build di cities wey Huram give am, and e make Israel pikin dem stay there.
Solomon go Hamath Zobah and win am.
E build Tadmor for di wilderness, and all di store cities wey e build for Hamath.
E build Beth Horon di upper and Beth Horon di lower, strong cities with walls, gates and bars,

and Baalath, and all di store cities wey Solomon get, and all di chariot cities, and di cities for di horsemen, and all wey Solomon want to build for im pleasure for Jerusalem, and for Lebanon, and for all di land wey im rule cover.
As for all di people wey remain of di Hittites, di Amorites, di Perizzites, di Hivites and di Jebusites, wey no be from Israel,
dem pikin dem wey remain after dem for di land, wey Israel pikin dem no finish, Solomon raise forced workers from dem till today.
But from Israel pikin dem Solomon no make anybody servant for im work, because dem be men of war, and chief of im captains, and rulers of im chariots and im horsemen.
Dis na di chief officers of King Solomon, 250, wey rule di people.

Solomon bring Pharaoh daughter up from David city to di house wey e build for am, because e talk say, “My wife no go stay for King David of Israel house, because di places holy wey di ark of di Lord don enter.”
Den Solomon offer burnt sacrifice to di Lord on di altar of di Lord wey e build before di porch,

as di duty of every day need, dey offer as Moses command, for Sabbaths, for new moons and for di fixed feasts, three times for year, for di feast of bread wey no get yeast, for di feast of weeks and for di feast of booths.

E appoint, as im papa David rule, di groups of di priests to dem service, and di Levites to dem duties, to praise and to serve before di priests as di duty of every day need, and di doorkeepers by dem groups for every gate, because na so David di man of God command.
Dem no turn from di king command to di priests and Levites about any matter or about di treasures.
All Solomon work dey ready from di day wey dem lay di foundation of di Lord house till e finish. So di Lord house complete.
Den Solomon go Ezion Geber and Eloth, for di seashore for Edom land.
Huram send ships to am by im servants hands, and servants wey know di sea, and dem go with Solomon servants to Ophir and carry 450 talents of gold from there, and bring am to King Solomon.

As di queen of Sheba hear about Solomon fame, e come to test Solomon with hard questions for Jerusalem, with very big group, with camels wey carry spices, and plenty gold and precious stones. As e reach Solomon, e talk with am about all wey dey im heart.
Solomon answer all im questions. Nothing dey wey hide from Solomon wey e no explain to am.
As di queen of Sheba see Solomon wisdom and di house wey e build,

and di food for im table, and how im servants dey sit, and how im ministers dey serve and dem clothes, and im cup bearers and dem clothes, and di stairs wey e dey use go up to di Lord house, no strength remain for am again.
E talk to di king say, “Na true report I hear for my own land about your works and your wisdom.
But I no believe dem words until I come and my eyes see am. And look, dem no even tell me half of di greatness of your wisdom! You pass di fame wey I hear.
Happy dey your men, happy dey dis your servants wey dey stand before you always and hear your wisdom.

Make dem bless di Lord your God, wey delight for you and set you for im throne to be king for di Lord your God. Because your God love Israel to make dem stand forever, so e make you king over dem to do justice and righteousness.”
E give di king 120 talents of gold, and very plenty spices and precious stones. Spice like wetin di queen of Sheba give King Solomon no dey again.
Huram servants and Solomon servants too, wey bring gold from Ophir, bring almug trees and precious stones.
Di king use di almug trees make steps for di Lord house and for di king house, and harps and stringed instruments for di singers. Dem no see anything like dat before for Judah land.
King Solomon give di queen of Sheba all wetin e want, anything wey e ask, apart from wetin e bring to di king. So e turn go im own land, e and im servants.
Di weight of gold wey come to Solomon for one year na 666 talents of gold,
apart from wetin di traders and merchants bring, and all di kings of Arabia and di governors of di country dey bring gold and silver to Solomon.
King Solomon make 200 big shields of beaten gold. 600 shekels of beaten gold dey go for one shield.
E make 300 small shields of beaten gold. 300 shekels of gold dey go for one shield, and di king put dem for di House of di Forest of Lebanon.
Di king make big throne of ivory too, and cover am with pure gold.
Six steps dey go di throne, with gold footstool wey dem fasten to di throne, and arms for each side by di place of di seat, and two lions dey stand beside di arms.
12 lions dey stand there for one side and for di other side for di six steps. Nothing like am dey make for any kingdom.
All King Solomon drinking cups na gold, and all di things for di House of di Forest of Lebanon na pure gold. None na silver, dem no count am as anything for Solomon days.
Because di king get ships wey dey go Tarshish with Huram servants. One time for every three years di ships of Tarshish dey come, dey bring gold, silver, ivory, monkeys and peacocks.
So King Solomon pass all di kings of di earth for riches and for wisdom.
All di kings of di earth dey look for Solomon face to hear im wisdom, wey God put for im heart.
Every man bring im gift, things of silver and things of gold, and clothes, weapons and spices, horses and mules, as dem dey do am year by year.
Solomon get 4,000 stalls for horses and chariots and 12,000 horsemen, wey e put for di chariot cities and with di king for Jerusalem.
E rule over all di kings from di River reach di land of di Philistines and reach Egypt border.
Di king make silver dey Jerusalem like stones, and e make cedars dey like di sycamore trees wey dey di low land, because dem plenty.
Dem dey bring horses for Solomon from Egypt and from all lands.

Di rest of wetin Solomon do, from first to last, dem no write dem for di history of Nathan di prophet, and for di prophecy of Ahijah di Shilonite, and for di visions of Iddo di seer about Jeroboam, Nebat pikin?
Solomon rule for Jerusalem over all Israel 40 years.
Solomon die join im papa dem, and dem bury am for im papa David city, and im pikin Rehoboam rule for im place.
